keys.help: How much compressed memory there is, as a share of installed memory.
keys.label: Compressed memory size

keys.help: How memory is compressed. zstd squeezes most; lz4 is fastest.
keys.label: Compression

keys.help: Which swap is used first. Higher is used first.
keys.label: Compressed memory priority

keys.help: Higher values move memory to swap sooner. The usual choice is 60, or higher with compressed memory.
keys.label: Swappiness

keys.help: How many pages are read back from swap at once, as a power of two. 0 suits compressed memory.
keys.label: Swap read-ahead

keys.help: How eagerly the file-name caches are given back. 100 is the kernel's default.
keys.label: File cache pressure

keys.help: How much memory the kernel keeps free, in tenths of a percent.
keys.label: Free memory headroom

keys.help: How hard the kernel reclaims after fragmentation. 0 turns it off.
keys.label: Memory boost
